scientific_integrity.statement: Complete three-direction contraction theorem proved by explicit matrix calculation; no independent validation claimed.

scientific_limitations: Strictly convex six-sided paired-direction polygons only; no general uniform rate for higher-side polygons.
Involute phase and relabeling must be respected.
A general finite linear-solve formula for the central point was already published; novelty is the explicit sharp three-direction contraction spectrum.
Literature access and mathematical originality are necessarily subject to independent assessment.
title: Sharp double-involute contraction and its barycentric center for symmetric hexagonal norms
